concerns.text: The plan specifies using Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction (see Phase 3 description), but Constitution Principle VI mandates a Bonferroni correction. This contradicts the constitution’s Statistical Transparency requirement.

The contract `contracts/analysis_results.schema.yaml` requires fields such as `beta_baseline`, `beta_full`, `delta`, `cohens_d`, and `vif` in `analysis_results.csv`, yet the plan’s Phase 3 description only mentions writing correlation and regression statistics without explicitly stating that these additional fields will be produced.
